manifoldParrot.description: manifold-parrot channel config. manifold-parrot is the built-in discuss channel that opens on iOS when a human-gate is blocked.

defaultAgent.description: Default agent for the manifold-parrot channel. Used when the blocked gate node does not declare its own discuss.agent.

taskflowRevive.description: Config for boot-time task orphan cleanup (absorbed from taskflow-revive plugin).

globalConcurrency.description: Shared ceiling for every flow-run concurrency mechanism — agent dispatch, subflow fan-out, and whole-flow-run concurrency alike (engine/global-concurrency.js). Default: 8.

pushUrl.description: Single URL manifold POSTs harness lifecycle events to for every harness (harness/push.js). Env: MANIFOLD_PUSH_URL.

pushUrls.description: Per-harness push URLs, keyed by harness id. Each value is a URL string or {url, bearer, timeoutMs}.

pushBearer.description: Bearer token sent as Authorization on single-URL pushes. Env: MANIFOLD_PUSH_BEARER.

pushTimeoutMs.description: Push POST timeout in milliseconds. Default: 3000. Env: MANIFOLD_PUSH_TIMEOUT_MS.

pushBaseUrl.description: Public base URL this harness POSTs back to, for push self-registration. Env: MANIFOLD_PUSH_BASE_URL.

profilePath.description: Absolute path of the PROFILE.md file guarded by the before_tool_call read gate and edit lock (hooks/profile-read-gate.js, hooks/profile-write-lock.js). Default: ~/.openclaw/workspace/.shared/freelance/profile/PROFILE.md

profileEditResultsDir.description: Directory the edit lock writes one <runId>.json outcome marker per guarded PROFILE.md edit into (hooks/profile-write-lock.js). Default: ~/.openclaw/locks/profile-edit-results
